purpose: Source registry and ingestion rules for Norwood.ma local events/news/community data.
whats_happening_include: Markets, fairs, festivals and vendor/craft events
Public workshops/classes with a specific date/time
Community organization events open to the public
Local, state and federal elections affecting Norwood voters
Public events held on the Norwood Town Common
whats_happening_exclude_default: Routine worship services or religious study
Routine municipal board meetings unless shown in a separate civic feed
Events outside Norwood without a strong Norwood-specific reason
Duplicate syndicated listings when a primary source exists
expiration_rule: Remove from upcoming feeds after event end; if no end is known, expire at 04:00 local time following the start date.
geography_rule: Norwood physical venue required by default. Regional sources may be monitored, but non-Norwood events are rejected unless explicitly tagged as materially Norwood-specific.

possible_conflicts.purpose: High-recall planning dataset, broader than What's Happening.
possible_conflicts.inclusion_rule: Retain any legitimate publicly discoverable Norwood-connected event that an event planner may want to consider, including meetings or activities not normally open to the general public.
possible_conflicts.filtering_rule: Do not filter merely because an event is routine, small, registration-based, organization-specific, school-family-specific, or outside Norwood when it involves a Norwood group or audience.
possible_conflicts.access_rule: Do not infer labels such as members-only or private. Preserve explicit access information from the source only when useful.
possible_conflicts.sources_rule: Monitor as many reliable Norwood-connected calendars and public schedules as practical, including schools/PTOs, youth sports, civic groups, houses of worship, clubs, arts groups, town departments, library, recreation, senior center and nonprofits.
possible_conflicts.relationship_to_main_calendar: Possible Conflicts includes all qualifying public calendar events plus supplemental conflict-only records; main-calendar eligibility remains independently curated.
